services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to be with you within an hour of your call, 24/7.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New efficient boilers fitted with full certification and 10-year warranty. Includes system design consultation and energy advice.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Maintenance
services.desc: Annual safety checks and repairs keep your heating running safely and efficiently. Extends boiler life and protects your warranty.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Installation
services.desc: Leaking radiators, cold spots, and full system upgrades. We balance systems and fit modern thermostatic valves to cut heating bills.

services.title: Bathroom & Shower Installation
services.desc: Complete bathroom design and installation, from pipework to tiling. We handle everything so you get a professional, watertight finish.

services.title: Wall & Floor Tiling
services.desc: Kitchens, bathrooms, and feature walls tiled to precision. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality materials for a lasting result.

about_pullquote: I started Russell Plumbing because I hated seeing customers ripped off by cowboys charging silly rates.
about_para_1: Russell Plumbing Heating and Tiling has served Huddersfield and the surrounding villages for over 18 years. We began as a one-man operation and have grown steadily by treating every job—whether a quick tap repair or a full boiler replacement—with the same care and attention. We're Gas Safe Registered and fully insured, and every engineer carries their credentials on the van.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we're honest about what needs doing, we turn up on time, and we don't disappear after the work is finished. We stand behind our work with warranties and aftercare support. Word of mouth has built our reputation across Huddersfield, Shelley, and neighbouring towns—and we're proud of that trust.
reviews_heading: What Huddersfield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare burst pipe in the kitchen just before Christmas. Russell came out the same afternoon and had it sorted within an hour. Didn't overcharge, explained everything clearly, and even left my kitchen tidy. Absolute lifesaver.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: New boiler fitted earlier this year. The whole job was organised brilliantly—they explained the options, fitted it cleanly, and didn't leave a mess. Heating bills are noticeably lower and it's been rock solid since. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Judith P.

reviews.text: Came in for an emergency radiator leak and ended up chatting about a full bathroom upgrade. No pressure, fair quote, and they finished on time and within budget. Very rare these days. Will have them back.
reviews.author: David M.
